jobs.title: AP Data Analysis & Continuous Improvement Specialist
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is looking for a AP Data Analysis & Continuous Improvement Specialist.

You will own the data and reporting layer of our AP function - building and maintaining the dashboards and KPI frameworks that give the team and leadership a real-time view of performance. Beyond reporting, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives end-to-end: identifying inefficiencies, designing solutions, coordinating input from the team and driving implementation.

You sit at the intersection of AP operations, data and process design. You will partner closely with the Global AP SME to ensure improvement initiatives align with global standards, and with the broader team to translate operational experience into measurable change.

You’re welcome to work in our offices in Amsterdam.

Your responsibilities will include:

Reporting and analytics

- Own AP reporting and dashboard management - maintain accuracy, relevance and accessibility of operational data

- Produce and interpret KPI reporting: on-time payment, ZIP aging, hold rates, escalation coverage and root cause analysis

- Identify trends, anomalies and patterns in AP data and translate them into actionable insights for the team and leadership

- Build and maintain automated reporting workflows - reduce manual data handling wherever possible

- Prepare ad hoc analysis for Finance leadership as needed

Continuous improvement

- Lead continuous improvement initiatives end-to-end - coordinate input from the team including Senior AP Accountants, design solutions, drive implementation and track outcomes

- Work with the Global AP SME to ensure improvement initiatives align with global process standards before implementation

- Support automation efforts and reduction of manual work within AP workflows

- Document process changes and ensure improvements are embedded and sustained

- Monitor the impact of changes through data - close the loop between initiative and outcome

We expect you to have:

- 4-6 years of experience in Finance Operations, AP analytics, FP&A, or a comparable analytical role within Finance

- Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience building dashboards and KPI frameworks - Excel (advanced), BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker or similar)

- Experience leading or coordinating process improvement projects from identification through to implementation

- Solid understanding of AP processes - you do not need to have been an AP accountant, but you need to understand how AP works

- Comfortable working with and extracting data from ERP systems - NetSuite experience is a strong advantage

- Structured, project-oriented approach to your work

- Strong communication skills - able to translate data into stories that non-analytical stakeholders can act on

- Excellent written and verbal English - English is our primary working language and the expected standard of communication throughout the team

- Working knowledge of spoken and written English

It will be an added bonus if you have:

- Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma or another continuous improvement methodology

- Experience with Zip, Blackline or similar AP-specific tools

- Exposure to automation tools or scripting (Python, SQL) for data workflows

- Experience in a high-growth or technology company

Benefits & Perks:

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

The role

We are creating an operations function within the Nebius communications organisation to support our External Communications, People Communications, and Sustainability teams.The operations team will help the whole communications organisation run more effectively, building the processes, tooling and coordination mechanisms that enable team members to focus on delivering an exceptional communications program.We are looking for someone to build this function. Reporting to the Chief Communications Officer, you will enjoy considerable autonomy and work closely with leaders across the communications organisation. You will also manage the day-to-day work of the communications organisation’s assistant, work closely with the Project Manager for AI adoption. As the function evolves, you may in time build out the operations team into a broader communications strategy and operations function

This role be located from our HQ in Amsterdam on a Hybrid model

What you will do

Team operations and coordination

- Own the communications team's operational rhythm: quarterly and annual planning; internal calendars; team events, meetings and offsites; and cross-team coordination

- Coordinate team events, offsites, and the operational side of the management meeting cycle

- Act as connective tissue across the communications organisation, to help ensure maximum alignment and avoid duplications of effort or working at cross-purposes

Strategy and project support

- Help develop and maintain the communications team's planning frameworks, OKRs, and goal-tracking

- Prepare materials for leadership reviews and internal reporting on team performance and pipeline

- Support senior leads on specific strategic projects as agreed

Budget and contracts

- Build and maintain robust budgeting processes that give leads clear visibility into their spend at any point in the year

- Oversee implementation of the communications team budget: tracking spend, flagging variances, managing purchase orders and invoicing with finance

- Manage vendor and agency contracts: renewals, onboarding, scope changes, and compliance with procurement processes

Tooling and AI

- Identify tooling needs and build the stack, from evaluation through to implementation and maintenance of third-party tools across the organisation

- Lead the communications team's adoption of AI tools, identifying where they add genuine value and helping team members use them effectively

- Work with IT and procurement to manage tool contracts, access, and spend

What we are looking for

Essential

- Demonstrated experience in an operations, strategy, or chief-of-staff type role, ideally within a communications, marketing, or media organisation

- Strong project management skills: you know how to design a process, stick to it, and adapt it when it isn't working

- Financial competence: comfortable managing budgets, tracking spend, and working with finance teams

- Comfortable working across a distributed team in multiple time zones

- Clear and direct communication style, written and verbal

- Pro-active approach to problem-solving – you are a self-starter who comes with solutions, not questions

- A strongly collaborative, low-ego approach based on building trust with the team and across the company

- Genuine interest in AI and technology: you don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be intellectually engaged with what we're building

Preferred

- Experience working in or closely with a communications or PR function

- Familiarity with communications and media tools (monitoring platforms, distribution tools, project management software)

- Experience working in a fast-scaling tech company or startup environment

- Exposure to AI tools in a professional context

- Experience working in international and multicultural environments is highly valued.

Job Description

Data Center Operations Manager – Facilities

Location: Lappeenranta, Finland Department: Data Center Operations / Critical Facilities Reports To: Regional Operations Director or Site Director

Position Summary

The Data Center Operations Manager – Facilities is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of all critical facility infrastructure within the data center campus in Lappeenranta, Finland. This role oversees day-to-day operations of mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), cooling, power distribution, and building management systems while ensuring maximum uptime, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in mission-critical facilities with leadership capability, vendor management experience, and a proactive operational mindset. The role requires maintaining high availability standards while supporting growth, sustainability initiatives, and continuous improvement programs.

Key Responsibilities

Critical Facility Operations

- Manage daily operations and maintenance of critical infrastructure systems including:

- UPS systems

- Generators

- Switchgear and transformers

- HVAC and cooling systems

- Chillers and CRAH/CRAC units

- Fire detection and suppression systems

- Building Management Systems (BMS)

- Electrical distribution systems

- Ensure continuous uptime and reliability of all mission-critical systems.

- Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and corrective action processes.

- Oversee preventive and predictive maintenance programs.

Team Leadership

- Lead and develop a team of facility engineers, technicians, and contractors.

- Establish shift coverage, escalation procedures, and operational standards.

- Promote a strong safety-first culture and operational discipline.

- Conduct performance reviews, training plans, and workforce development.

Operational Excellence

- Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), emergency operating procedures (EOPs), and method of procedures (MOPs).

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives for reliability, efficiency, and sustainability.

- Monitor KPIs including uptime, energy efficiency, incident response, and maintenance completion.

- Support capacity planning and infrastructure expansion projects.

Vendor & Contractor Management

- Manage relationships with external service providers and contractors.

- Ensure vendors comply with site safety requirements, SLAs, and operational standards.

- Coordinate maintenance windows and project execution activities.

Compliance & Safety

- Ensure compliance with Finnish regulations, environmental standards, and industry best practices.

- Support ISO, environmental, and operational audits.

- Maintain compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) programs.

- Participate in risk assessments and emergency preparedness activities.

Sustainability & Energy Management

- Support energy efficiency initiatives and sustainability targets.

- Monitor PUE and optimize cooling and electrical efficiency.

- Contribute to renewable energy integration and environmental performance programs where applicable.

Qualifications

Required

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

- 5–10+ years of experience in critical facilities or data center operations.

- Strong knowledge of electrical and mechanical infrastructure in mission-critical environments.

- Experience managing technical teams in a 24/7 operational environment.

- Knowledge of data center operational standards and best practices.

- Familiarity with CMMS systems and facility monitoring platforms.

- Strong problem-solving and incident management skills.

- Excellent communication skills in English.

Preferred

- Experience working in hyperscale or colocation data centers.

- Knowledge of Finnish workplace safety and environmental regulations.

- Experience with energy optimization and sustainability programs.

- Certifications such as:

- CDCP / CDCS

- Data Center Facilities Engineer certifications

- OSHA or equivalent safety certifications

- Electrical or mechanical trade qualifications

- Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.

Key Competencies

- Leadership and team management

- Critical thinking and decision-making

- Incident and crisis management

- Operational planning and execution

- Vendor and stakeholder management

- Reliability-focused mindset

- Strong safety awareness

- Continuous improvement orientation

Work Environment

- 24/7 mission-critical data center environment.

- On-call availability may be required.

- Occasional travel within the Nordic region may be required.

- Work may involve exposure to electrical and mechanical equipment areas.

Benefits & Perks:

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

The Role

Nebius is building next generation, high density AI infrastructure, and we are looking for a  Data Center Operations Manager - Critical Infrastructure  to own the performance, reliability, and operational excellence of our data center facilities.

This is a  critical facilities leadership role , responsible for  power, cooling, and environmental systems  that support GPU driven workloads. You will ensure our sites operate with  maximum uptime, efficiency, and safety , while also supporting  capacity expansion and infrastructure improvements  as we scale.

Unlike a pure construction role, this position is focused on  steady-state operations, incident management, and long term facility performance , with involvement in  commissioning and new site readiness  where needed.

Responsibilities:

Critical Facilities Operations

- Own day to day operations of  electrical and mechanical systems  including UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, and cooling infrastructure

- Ensure  high availability and uptime  of all critical systems supporting data center operations

- Lead  incident response  for facility related events, including root cause analysis and corrective actions

- Monitor system performance via BMS/DCIM and drive improvements in reliability and efficiency

Maintenance & Vendor Management

- Oversee  preventive and corrective maintenance programs  for all facility systems

- Manage and hold accountable  third party vendors and service providers

Capacity, Efficiency & Optimization

- Data Center Operations teams

- Support broader operational goals around  scalability, reliability, and standardization

Requirements:

- Strong hands on knowledge of  critical infrastructure systems :

- Electrical distribution (UPS, generators, switchgear)

- Cooling systems (chillers, HVAC, CRAH/CRAC, liquid cooling exposure preferred)

- Experience operating in  high availability environments  with strict uptime requirements

- Proven experience managing  vendors, maintenance programs, and incident response

- Familiarity with  BMS/DCIM systems and operational monitoring

- Experience developing and enforcing  SOPs, EOPs, and MOPs

jobs.title: General Manager, Data Center (New Build)
jobs.location: Independence, Missouri, United States; United States
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Why work at Nebius

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud computing to serve the global AI economy. We create the tools and resources our customers need to solve real-world challenges and transform industries, without massive infrastructure costs or the need to build large in-house AI/ML teams. Our employees work at the cutting edge of AI cloud infrastructure alongside some of the most experienced and innovative leaders and engineers in the field.

Where we work

Headquartered in Amsterdam and listed on Nasdaq, Nebius has a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, North America, and Israel. Our teams bring together deep expertise across hardware, software, networking, data center infrastructure, and AI to build and operate the infrastructure behind large-scale GPU computing.

The team

You will build and lead the organization responsible for deploying and operating Nebius AI infrastructure at our Independence, Missouri campus. Your team will bring together data center IT operations, critical facilities, networking, logistics, operational readiness, and supporting functions.

You will work closely with hardware, network, engineering, cloud, commercial, and corporate teams to bring compute capacity into service and establish reliable, scalable operations.

The role

We are seeking a General Manager, Data Center to lead the organizational build-out, hardware deployment, operational readiness, and ongoing performance of our gigawatt-scale data center campus in Independence, Missouri. This is an on-site leadership role with responsibility for the Independence campus.

You will have autonomy to design the campus organization, select your leadership team, define reporting lines, and establish the operating model within agreed budgets and company standards. You will own operational readiness and campus performance across critical facilities and IT infrastructure, aligning people, systems, and service partners to deliver reliable customer capacity.

The facility is currently under construction. You will partner with construction, engineering, and critical facilities teams to align facility completion, commissioning, and handover with hardware deployment and operational readiness. You will establish the operating team and coordinate GPU, server, network, and storage installation, integration, acceptance testing, and cloud readiness with the responsible technical teams and service providers.

This role offers the opportunity to shape the operating practices that support Nebius as its AI infrastructure business grows.

Your responsibilities will include:

Organization Design and Leadership

- Design and build the campus organization, including functional leadership, building and shift coverage, reporting lines, and clear decision authority.

- Hire, lead, and develop directors, data center managers, and operations teams in partnership with Talent Acquisition and HR.

- Own the phased workforce plan, aligning recruitment, training, contractor support, and leadership coverage with hardware deployment, acceptance testing, and production milestones.

- Establish performance expectations, consistent technical competency standards, and succession plans that support reliable campus operations and sustained performance.

Operational Deployment and Readiness

- Own the integrated operational readiness plan connecting facility completion and handover milestones, equipment delivery, hardware installation, network and storage integration, staffing, and customer service readiness.

- Coordinate with construction and facilities teams to verify power, cooling, and space readiness before deployment; manage dependencies and escalate gaps that could delay bringing capacity into service.

- Define operational acceptance criteria for the campus and deployed infrastructure, coordinate readiness and acceptance testing with technical owners, and accept or withhold operational handover against agreed requirements.

- Ensure trained teams, tested procedures, critical spares, asset records, monitoring, and vendor support are in place before production operations begin.

- Coordinate GPU, server, network fabric, storage, and cloud readiness with technical owners, and jointly confirm that released capacity can support customer workloads.

- Sequence hardware installation, integration, and production changes to protect live environments as additional compute capacity comes online.

Campus Operations and Reliability

- Own end-to-end campus operations across critical facilities and IT infrastructure, delivering agreed uptime, performance, and service levels.

- Establish 24/7 coverage, maintenance governance, change control, incident command, root-cause analysis, and business continuity practices.

- Ensure clear responsibility across power, liquid cooling, controls, hardware, networking, and cloud interfaces; hold owners accountable for corrective actions.

- Use monitoring, automation, and performance reporting to improve deployment throughput, repair turnaround, reliability, and operating efficiency.

Financial Capacity and Asset Management

- Own campus operating budgets, workforce costs, vendor expenditure, and forecasts within delegated authority; contribute to capital planning and investment priorities.

- Align power, cooling, rack space, equipment, and staffing capacity with deployment plans, and address constraints affecting customer commitments.

- Establish asset inventory, receiving, logistics, critical spares, repair, warranty-return, and secure disposition processes.

- Track budget variance, rework, delayed capacity, and operational losses; drive corrective actions and report financial impacts clearly.

Partners, City Coordination, Safety and Executive Accountability

- Serve as the primary operational interface with utilities, infrastructure providers, equipment manufacturers, vendors, and service partners.

- Coordinate with City of Independence departments alongside Public Affairs and Legal on site readiness, permitting and inspections, utility interfaces, emergency preparedness, and ongoing operational matters; align external communications and commitments with the responsible teams.

- Hold providers accountable for safety, quality, delivery milestones, response times, and contractual service performance.

- Ensure safety, environmental, physical security, and applicable compliance requirements are implemented with the responsible specialists and corporate teams.

- Provide executive visibility into launch progress, workforce readiness, operating performance, financial forecasts, and risks requiring decisions.

Operational Scalability and Leadership Development

- Develop repeatable deployment standards, staffing models, acceptance practices, and operating procedures that support the campus as compute capacity scales.

- Build leadership succession and delegation practices that sustain reliable operations and develop future infrastructure leaders.

- Share lessons and operational improvements with the broader Nebius infrastructure organization.

We expect you to have:

- 10+ years of experience in data center, cloud infrastructure, or comparable mission-critical operations, including senior leadership responsibility.

- A track record of building and scaling organizations and leading managers across multiple technical and operational functions.

- Experience leading hardware deployment, infrastructure integration, operational acceptance, or major compute capacity expansion into production service.

- Strong understanding of critical facilities, including power and cooling, and how those systems affect IT availability and high-density compute operations.

- Leadership experience across compute, networking, storage, and infrastructure lifecycle management, with the technical judgment to coordinate specialist teams.

- Demonstrated ownership of operating budgets, workforce planning, vendor performance, and executive reporting.

- Experience leading incident response, change management, risk reduction, and service improvement in high-availability environments.

- The ability to exercise sound judgment, make decisions with incomplete information, address underperformance directly, and align stakeholders around clear outcomes.

- Ability to work on site in Independence, Missouri and provide visible leadership through deployment, launch, and ongoing operations.

Nice to have:

- Experience in hyperscale, AI, GPU, or high-performance computing environments, including large-scale GPU deployments and high-density infrastructure.

- Experience with liquid-cooled environments and the operational interfaces between cooling systems, GPU platforms, and network fabrics.

- Experience managing multiple campuses or regional operations and transferring operating practices across sites.

- Experience building operating organizations and establishing processes during initial hardware deployment and the transition into production service.

- Experience using infrastructure automation, telemetry, and reliability data to improve capacity delivery and operating performance.

Key employee benefits

- Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental and vision coverage for employees and families.

- 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.

- Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.

- Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.

- Disability and life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

jobs.title: Senior FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Overview

The FP&A Analyst – Business Cases & Investments plays a critical role within the Group Finance team, evaluating strategic and operational investment decisions across the business. The role demands a highly analytical individual capable of operating with autonomy, synthesising complex financial and non-financial data, and delivering clear, evidence-based recommendations to senior leadership.

This is a high-visibility role that partners directly with business unit leaders, the Executive team, and cross-functional stakeholders to appraise capital allocation decisions, model scenarios, track cashflow implications, and monitor delivery against approved cases. The ideal candidate combines rigorous financial modelling skills with commercial acumen and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.

Key Responsibilities

Business Case & Investment Modelling

- Develop, own, and continuously refine financial models for business cases, investment proposals, and strategic initiatives across the Group.

- Build scenario, sensitivity, and Monte Carlo analyses to quantify risk and opportunity, providing decision-makers with a range of credible outcomes.

- Translate complex financial and operational assumptions into coherent, auditable model structures that can be understood and challenged by non-technical stakeholders.

- Evaluate capital expenditure proposals, including ROI, IRR, NPV, and payback analysis across short- and long-term horizons.

- Work with limited direction and exercise sound judgment to determine the right analytical approach for each investment question.

Cashflow Modelling & Forecasting

- Build and maintain detailed cashflow models that integrate operating, investing, and financing activities — both at the project level and as part of Group-wide forecasts.

- Develop long-term (multi-year) cashflow forecasts, incorporating business case assumptions, capex schedules, and working capital dynamics.

- Model cashflow sensitivity to key assumptions (revenue ramp, capex timing, financing draws) to support liquidity planning and covenant monitoring.

- Analyse forecast vs. actual cashflow variances, identifying root causes and providing actionable insight to improve future forecast accuracy.

- Quantify the cashflow impact of proposed investments and business cases, including funding requirements, drawdown profiles, and payback timelines.

- Support treasury and corporate finance teams with cashflow projections used in debt facility negotiations, ABL covenant reporting, and investor communications.

Data Analysis & Insight Generation

- Integrate multiple financial and non-financial data sources (operational KPIs, market data, customer metrics, engineering outputs) to form a holistic view of investment performance and potential.

- Identify data gaps and work proactively with Finance, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence teams to improve the quality and availability of inputs.

- Monitor approved investments post-close, tracking actual performance against business case assumptions and providing clear variance commentary.

- Develop insight-led reporting that goes beyond the numbers — surfacing the 'so what' for leadership audiences.

Strategic & Financial Planning Support

- Support the FP&A team in long-range planning cycles, integrating investment pipeline analysis with Group P&L and cashflow forecasts.

- Prepare P&L, balance sheet, and cashflow impacts of proposed investments, including funding structure implications.

- Contribute to Group-wide scenario planning and stress-testing exercises that inform the annual budget and strategic plan.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

- Present findings and recommendations to senior management and the Executive team in a clear, structured, and commercially oriented way.

- Act as a credible financial partner to business unit heads, challenging assumptions and embedding rigorous financial thinking into decision-making processes.

- Collaborate with Finance Business Partners, Legal, Strategy, and Operations teams to ensure investment proposals are well-scoped and assumptions are grounded.

- Prepare high-quality materials for Investment Committee and Board-level review.

Key Qualifications & Experience

Must-Have Requirements

- 6+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment analysis, or management consulting.

- Proven track record building complex, multi-driver financial models from scratch in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Demonstrated experience constructing cashflow models and forecasts, including direct and indirect cashflow methods, working capital movements, and capex scheduling.

- Strong understanding of investment appraisal techniques (NPV, IRR, payback, scenario analysis) and financial statement mechanics (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow).

- Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal direction, managing multiple workstreams concurrently.

- Experience synthesising financial and non-financial data to produce actionable business insights.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders.

- Strong commercial awareness and the ability to translate analytical output into strategic context.

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to infrastructure-heavy, tech, AI, or SaaS business models.

- Experience with ABL or other asset-backed financing structures and associated cashflow reporting requirements.

- Experience with planning and BI tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, Tableau, Power BI, Looker).

- Familiarity with NetSuite or similar ERP platforms.

- Professional qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CFA) or equivalent analytical training.

Competencies & Behavioural Traits

Analytical Excellence

- Rigour: Exceptional attention to detail combined with the ability to see the big picture.

- Problem-solving: Structured approach; breaks ambiguous questions into tractable analyses.

- Data fluency: High comfort with large, complex, and imperfect data sets.

Communication & Influence

- Storytelling: Translates complex modelling outputs into clear business narratives.

- Executive presence: Confident presenting to senior audiences, with the ability to field tough questions.

- Proactivity: Proactively shares insights and flags risks rather than waiting to be asked.

Collaboration & Ownership

- Partnerships: Builds trusted relationships across Finance and with business stakeholders.

- Accountability: Takes ownership of outputs end-to-end, from data collection through to recommendation.

- Adaptability: Comfortable operating with ambiguity and adapting approach as priorities evolve.

- Resilience: High resilience and sound judgment in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Benefits & Perks:

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams
